summary_1line: Bhishma explains the sacred origin and supremacy of gold as a purifying gift, recounting ancestral visions and sages’ teachings to Rama about gold’s divine essence.

image_candidates.scene_text: During the funeral rite, a jeweled arm suddenly rises from the earth through the kusa grass as Bhishma prepares to offer the obsequial cake.
Bhishma sleeps at night as radiant ancestral spirits appear in his dream, praising his adherence to sacred law.
Rishis including Vasishtha speak to the warrior Rama, explaining that brilliant gold sprang from the fiery seed of Agni.
